issues.problem: ctx 5 (agreeing to lend money) fits 毫不犹豫 just as well
issues.action: Rewrote it so the contrast with thinking it over makes 不假思索 the fit

issues.problem: ctx 4 (name on a group project he did no work for) and the cue (parents paying for everything) fit 坐享其成, enjoying what others earned, just as well
issues.action: Rewrote ctx 4 (wanting a well-paid job with no work) and the cue (lottery tickets and easy-money schemes) so no one else's labour is involved

issues.problem: bad 2 (不劳而获了一大笔钱) is not clearly wrong; a verb-plus-object use does turn up in real writing
issues.action: Replaced it with a misuse that contradicts the idiom: hard work leading to a promotion

issues.problem: ctx 5 English says 'had he come' but 送来 means 'brought in'
ctx 1 连个电话都没留 is ambiguous and the English 'phone number' was a guess
issues.action: Changed it to 连张纸条都没留 ('not even a note')

issues.problem: bad 2 (used to mean death) is not clearly wrong; it does appear as a metaphor in tributes to people who died
issues.action: Replaced it with a grammar misuse: 不辞而别了这家公司, with the idiom given an object

issues.problem: lit said 'even for a moment', but 或 here means 'even slightly', not time
issues.action: Changed lit to 'cannot be lacking even slightly'

issues.problem: 必不可少 is a near-complete synonym and could fill most of the contexts
issues.action: Noted only. The two cannot really be told apart; the near diff (register) stays as the distinction

issues.problem: bad 2 (不遗余力地睡了一整天) could be read as a deliberate joke, so it is not clearly wrong
issues.action: Replaced it with a contradiction: passing an easy exam effortlessly

issues.problem: Checked the story against 论语·学而 (有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎): accurate
